question: The value of [ {6 + 3 of 7 - 5} ] div 2 of 11 is:
solution:
**Given:**

**[ {6 + 3 of 7 - 5} ] ÷ 2 of 11**

**Concept Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8122f7ba128d7085a0bd6d3fb67cb299754954e6531345df3fa4fb12005c9baf.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ [ {6 + 3 of 7 - 5} ] ÷ 2 of 11

⇒ [ {6 + 21 - 5 } ] ÷ 22

⇒ [27 - 5] ÷ 22

⇒ 22 ÷ 22

⇒ 1

**∴ The required answer is 1.**
